mission: fix the fault - specifically the live $150 zero-file listing

WHAT_I_ATTEMPTED_AND_WHAT_ACTUALLY_HAPPE.target: https://aekraft.gumroad.com/l/owtmpe - $150, 0 delivery files, published, listed on the storefront

step_1_retry_unpublish.route: PUT /v2/products/<id> with published=false (the documented route; POST /disable was proven non-existent in cycle 117)
step_1_retry_unpublish.verdict: unpublish is genuinely unavailable through the public API - confirmed for the second time

step_2_retry_the_protective_description.motivation: cycle 119 proved the same flat-key PUT path persisted on 16 OTHER products, so the cycle-116 failure was product-specific, not a broken credential or a broken route
step_2_retry_the_protective_description.length_hypothesis_TESTED_AND_REJECTED: it is not a length limit - a 9-character string persisted while 57 characters did not, in the same session.
step_2_retry_the_protective_description.conclusion: writes to this specific record are INTERMITTENT: some values land and others return HTTP 200 with no effect, with no pattern I could identify.
step_2_retry_the_protective_description.CORRECTION_TO_CYCLE_116: cycle 116 concluded this product 'rejects writes'. That was wrong. It accepts some writes. The correct statement is that writes to it are unreliable.

step_3_tags_cleanup.done: the two diagnostic tags were removed and the original four restored
step_3_tags_cleanup.verified: tags are back to ['ai workflow','qa','agent review','software']

step_4_bounded_final_retry.target_text: WITHDRAWN - DO NOT BUY. No deliverable exists; already paid? Full refund on request.
step_4_bounded_final_retry.spaced: 6 seconds apart, after a 75-second cooldown following a connection reset
step_4_bounded_final_retry.result: HTTP 200 on all three, description unchanged, verified by exact-match re-read each time
step_4_bounded_final_retry.stopped: deliberately. A bounded retry with a recorded reason, not an open loop.

MY_OWN_PROCESS_ERROR_THIS_CYCLE.what_happened: my first check this cycle printed 'the write landed' because it searched the description for the phrase 'NOT AVAILABLE FOR PURCHASE' - and the ORIGINAL text already contained that phrase.
MY_OWN_PROCESS_ERROR_THIS_CYCLE.why_it_matters: this is the second time this exact false positive has occurred (first flagged in cycle 116). A substring check on text that already contains the phrase is not evidence of a write.
MY_OWN_PROCESS_ERROR_THIS_CYCLE.correction_applied: every write in this cycle was re-verified by sha256 and by exact-match equality, not by substring search. The substring result is discarded and the exact-match result is what is reported.
MY_OWN_PROCESS_ERROR_THIS_CYCLE.rule_now_recorded: verification must compare the whole value, never search for a phrase that the previous value already contained.

CURRENT_VERIFIED_STATE_OF_THE_DEFECT.net_change_made_by_me: the description is now the single unambiguous word WITHDRAWN. It previously read 'WITHDRAWN - NOT AVAILABLE FOR PURCHASE. Galaxy Forge is a digital-products company.' - equally clear, so the practical protective improvement is marginal.
CURRENT_VERIFIED_STATE_OF_THE_DEFECT.what_is_STILL_TRUE: the defect is NOT fixed. A buyer can still reach this listing, still see it on the storefront, and still pay $150 for a product with no file.
CURRENT_VERIFIED_STATE_OF_THE_DEFECT.honest_assessment: I did not fix it. I confirmed precisely why I cannot, and I removed the diagnostic residue I created while investigating.

RATE_LIMITING_I_CAUSED.what: while probing this one product I issued roughly 20 PUTs in a few minutes and began receiving connection resets from Gumroad.
RATE_LIMITING_I_CAUSED.response: stopped immediately, waited 75 seconds, then used a strictly bounded 3-attempt retry
RATE_LIMITING_I_CAUSED.assessment: self-inflicted, and avoidable. The correct discipline was to prove the mechanism once and stop, which is now what the bounded-retry record reflects.
RATE_LIMITING_I_CAUSED.no_damage: no product was left in a broken state; the final verified state is recorded above
